observations.says: the cup was on its shelf when the lamp was lit
Bell went out with his sack before the lamp was lit
the cup was still there when the lamp was lit
by then Bell was in mid-river, and on the ferry until eight
the ferry lay at the far bank all night: he could not come back
the vestry was locked when the lamp was lit, and the lock was never forced: whoever took the cup had a key
there are two keys, the vicar's and the sexton's
and there is no other boat on the water
Bell's sack went out at the gate before the lamp was lit, while the cup was still on its shelf
